best_for: People juggling several email accounts on Mac and Windows who want one smart inbox, and who are comfortable with a service that keeps account tokens on its servers.

points.title: Free for personal use
points.text: The free plan covers a Smart Inbox, unlimited email accounts, smart notifications and a calendar. It includes only 5 lifetime meeting notes and a short trial of the AI features.

points.title: Plus and Pro prices
points.text: Plus is USD 99 a year (about USD 8.25 per month) or USD 10 monthly. Pro is USD 199 a year (about USD 16.58 per month) or USD 20 monthly, and adds unlimited meeting notes and AI auto-drafts. Prices are per user and were read on the date below.

points.title: Teams hit a ceiling on free
points.text: Free teams are limited to 2 active collaborators and 10 assignments. Paid plans remove those caps and add shared inboxes, shared drafts and private comments.

points.title: Your login lives on Spark's servers
points.text: For Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo, Spark keeps an access token on its servers. For Exchange, AOL and custom IMAP, that stored token is your actual login and password, encrypted. Push notifications also pass a short, encrypted part of each message through Spark.

points.title: Works with most providers
points.text: It connects to Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Exchange, Yahoo and any IMAP account, and there are apps for iPhone, iPad and Android to match the desktop.

points.title: Mac and Windows details
points.text: The Mac app needs macOS 13 or later and is universal. Windows installs per user, so no admin rights are needed. The Windows listing keeps 175 versions; macOS lists only the current release. There is no Linux app.
